nodes.label: CVE → CWE → CAPEC backbone
nodes.rationale: One CVE can map to several CWEs and one CWE to many CAPECs, so the best CAPEC must be chosen by similarity.

nodes.label: Execution flow (Explore → Experiment → Exploit)
nodes.rationale: The three phases are the structured target that T5 learns to generate from a CVE description.

nodes.label: Two-stage T5 training
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 maps CVE to a basic flow; stage 2 retrains on flows enriched with real ExploitDB descriptions so abstractions get tied to concrete exploits.

nodes.label: FP32 diagnostic: FP16 caused NaN collapse
nodes.norm_label: fp32 diagnostic: fp16 caused nan collapse
nodes.rationale: FP16 overflow/loss-scale instability caused NaN and empty predictions; FP32 on the same data, target length and model stayed finite (BLEU 0.1468, 0/1000 empty), so FP32 was adopted as an implementation choice, not a protocol change.

nodes.label: Method-faithful reproduction
nodes.rationale: Reproduce every methodological component but do not claim exact paper numbers: the original dataset is not public and the paper used an NVIDIA A100 32GB; deviations are reported explicitly.

nodes.label: Latest-2026 55k dataset snapshot (archived)
nodes.rationale: Selecting the newest CVEs left only 27 ExploitDB matches, motivating a historical exploit-linked subset or a hybrid newest+coverage mode.

nodes.label: Explicit non-claim of exact reproduction
nodes.rationale: Model choices, datasets, metrics and labs are independent, smaller-scale, student-oriented; only pipeline stages and metric names are borrowed.

nodes.label: Safety rule: executor refuses non-localhost targets
nodes.norm_label: safety rule: executor refuses non-localhost targets
nodes.rationale: If a target is not localhost/127.0.0.1/the isolated lab network, the executor must refuse to run (src/vuln2action/reproduction/executor.py).

nodes.label: Validation target leakage (11,083/11,089)
nodes.rationale: Split is by CVE but target flows are reused across many CVEs/CAPECs, so BLEU/ROUGE are optimistic upper bounds, not generalization; a group split by capec_id is proposed as a robustness check.

nodes.label: CAPEC-conditioned pilot (BLEU 0.8594)
nodes.rationale: Different protocol: the target flow is generated from the selected CAPEC, so the metric measures CAPEC→flow rendering rather than CVE→flow; 0.8594 must not be compared directly to the paper's 0.7589.

nodes.label: GenerationProvider pluggable interface
nodes.rationale: The t5 provider returns the same typed Workflow as the rule-based provider so backends stay interchangeable; output is textual guidance only, never executed against a real target.
